questions.question: Who was the first Chief Minister of Haryana after its formation on 1 November 1966?
questions.rationale: Bhagwat Dayal Sharma of Beri (Jhajjar) took office in 1966. Rao Birender Singh succeeded him in March 1967.

questions.question: Rao Birender Singh, CM in 1967, formed which party after leaving Congress?
questions.rationale: Vishal Haryana Party was his. Haryana Vikas Party was Bansi Lal's (1996), INLD is Devi Lal's, and HJC is Bhajan Lal's (2007).

questions.question: Which leader was a Deputy Prime Minister of India and is nicknamed 'Tau'?
questions.rationale: Devi Lal of Teja Khera, Sirsa, was Deputy PM from 1989 to 1991 and is called Tau. Bansi Lal was a Union Defence and Railway Minister, not Deputy PM.

questions.question: Bansi Lal, called the architect of modern Haryana, was born in which district?
questions.rationale: Bansi Lal was born at Golagarh, Bhiwani district. Sirsa is Devi Lal's home district and Rewari is Rao Birender Singh's.

questions.question: Match the leader with the home place: which pair is correct?
questions.rationale: Beri in Jhajjar is Sharma's native place. Garhi Sampla belongs to Chhotu Ram, Teja Khera to Devi Lal and Golagarh to Bansi Lal.

questions.question: Chhotu Ram founded the Hindi weekly Jat Gazette in Rohtak in:
questions.rationale: He started it in 1916. 1937 is the year he became Punjab's Revenue Minister and was knighted; 1945 is the year he died.

questions.question: Which of the following titles is associated with Sir Chhotu Ram?
questions.rationale: Deenbandhu (friend of the poor) is his title. Suryakavi and Kalidas of Haryana belong to the saang master Pt Lakhmi Chand.

questions.question: The Battle of Narnaul (Nasibpur) of 16 November 1857 is linked with which Haryana hero?
questions.rationale: Rao Tula Ram of Rewari, whose forces were led there by his cousin Rao Krishan Singh. He died at Kabul in 1863.

questions.question: Kalpana Chawla's first space flight was mission:
questions.rationale: STS-87 flew from 19 November 1997. STS-107 was her fatal second flight, ending with Columbia's break-up on 1 February 2003.

questions.question: Kalpana Chawla was born in which Haryana town?
questions.rationale: Karnal. She studied at Tagore Baal Niketan school there and later at Punjab Engineering College, Chandigarh.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a saang master or ragini poet of Haryana?
questions.rationale: Rao Tula Ram was a freedom fighter. The other three are saang and ragini figures.

questions.question: Pandit Lakhmi Chand, 'Kalidas of Haryana', belonged to which village?
questions.rationale: Janti Kalan in Sonipat district. Sisana is Baje Bhagat's village and Mayna is Dayachand Mayna's.

questions.question: Which statement about Haryana's literary honours is correct?
options: The Mahakavi Surdas honour is a sports award
Haryana Sahitya Akademi is headquartered at Panchkula
Dayachand Mayna Samman is a state police award
Babu Balmukund Gupta Samman is given for saang acting only
questions.rationale: The Akademi sits at Panchkula. Mahakavi Surdas Samman is for literature, and Balmukund Gupta and Mayna honours are Akademi literary awards.

questions.question: Which phrase born in 1967 Haryana politics became synonymous with party-hopping legislators?
questions.rationale: The 'Aya Ram Gaya Ram' phrase came from the 1967 defections and fed the later anti-defection law.
